data.template.yaml:
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
    annotations:
        adhar.io/batch-actor: ""
    labels:
        adhar.io/application: importer
        adhar.io/batch-job: importer
        adhar.io/batch-role: single
        adhar.io/batch-trigger: manual
        adhar.io/component: app
        adhar.io/environment: prod
        adhar.io/organisation: acme
        adhar.io/plane: workload
        adhar.io/project: shop
        adhar.io/team: payments
        adhar.io/workload: batch
        app.kubernetes.io/name: importer
    namespace: prod
spec:
    activeDeadlineSeconds: 21600
    backoffLimit: 2
    completions: 1
    parallelism: 1
    podFailurePolicy:
        rules:
            - action: Ignore
              onPodConditions:
                - status: "True"
                  type: DisruptionTarget
            - action: FailJob
              onExitCodes:
                containerName: batch
                operator: In
                values:
                    - 2
                    - 3
                    - 4
                    - 6
                    - 7
    podReplacementPolicy: Failed
    template:
        metadata:
            annotations:
                adhar.io/batch-actor: ""
                cluster-autoscaler.kubernetes.io/safe-to-evict: "false"
            labels:
                adhar.io/application: importer
                adhar.io/batch-job: importer
                adhar.io/batch-role: single
                adhar.io/batch-trigger: manual
                adhar.io/component: app
                adhar.io/environment: prod
                adhar.io/organisation: acme
                adhar.io/plane: workload
                adhar.io/project: shop
                adhar.io/team: payments
                adhar.io/workload: batch
                app.kubernetes.io/name: importer
        spec:
            containers:
                - env:
                    - name: ADHAR_BATCH_JOB
                      value: importJob
                    - name: ADHAR_BATCH_NAME
                      value: importer
                    - name: ADHAR_BATCH_ROLE
                      value: single
                    - name: ADHAR_BATCH_TRIGGER
                      value: manual
                    - name: ADHAR_BATCH_PARAMS
                      value: '{}'
                    - name: ADHAR_BATCH_TIME_ZONE
                      value: Asia/Singapore
                    - name: ADHAR_BATCH_REPOSITORY_SCHEMA
                      value: batch
                    - name: ADHAR_BATCH_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT
                      value: 90s
                    - name: ADHAR_BATCH_K8S_JOB
                      valueFrom:
                        fieldRef:
                            apiVersion: v1
                            fieldPath: metadata.labels['batch.kubernetes.io/job-name']
                    - name: ADHAR_BATCH_ACTOR
                      valueFrom:
                        fieldRef:
                            apiVersion: v1
                            fieldPath: metadata.annotations['adhar.io/batch-actor']
                    - name: POD_NAME
                      valueFrom:
                        fieldRef:
                            apiVersion: v1
                            fieldPath: metadata.name
                    - name: POD_UID
                      valueFrom:
                        fieldRef:
                            apiVersion: v1
                            fieldPath: metadata.uid
                    - name: NODE_NAME
                      valueFrom:
                        fieldRef:
                            apiVersion: v1
                            fieldPath: spec.nodeName
                    - name: ADHAR_ENVIRONMENT
                      value: prod
                    - name: SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL
                      valueFrom:
                        secretKeyRef:
                            key: jdbc-uri
                            name: importer-db-app
                    - name: SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME
                      valueFrom:
                        secretKeyRef:
                            key: username
                            name: importer-db-app
                    - name: SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD
                      valueFrom:
                        secretKeyRef:
                            key: password
                            name: importer-db-app
                    - name: BPL_JVM_THREAD_COUNT
                      value: "50"
                    - name: JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS
                      value: -XX:ReservedCodeCacheSize=64M
                    - name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
                      value: http://alloy.adhar-system.svc.cluster.local:4318
                    - name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL
                      value: http/protobuf
                    - name: OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER
                      value: otlp
                    - name: OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES
                      value: deployment.environment.name=prod,deployment.environment=prod,service.namespace=prod,k8s.namespace.name=prod,k8s.pod.name=$(POD_NAME),adhar.application=importer,adhar.batch.job=importer
                    - name: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME
                      value: importer
                  envFrom:
                    - secretRef:
                        name: importer-inbound-bucket
                  image: harbor-core.adhar-system.svc.cluster.local/library/importer@sha256:1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111
                  name: batch
                  resources:
                    limits:
                        memory: 1536Mi
                    requests:
                        cpu: "1"
                        memory: 1536Mi
                  securityContext:
                    allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
                    capabilities:
                        drop:
                            - ALL
                  volumeMounts:
                    - mountPath: /tmp
                      name: tmp
            enableServiceLinks: false
            imagePullSecrets:
                - name: harbor-dockercfg
            priorityClassName: adhar-batch-critical
            restartPolicy: Never
            schedulerName: default-scheduler
            securityContext:
                runAsNonRoot: true
                seccompProfile:
                    type: RuntimeDefault
            serviceAccountName: importer-batch
            terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 120
            volumes:
                - emptyDir:
                    sizeLimit: 1Gi
                  name: tmp
    ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 604800
